principle: Owner 2026-10-26: 'a factory that is not perfect, but can evolve over time and report the known issues to be solved by a Human.'

issues.title: Five diagnosis protocol trials not run: no qualified alternative local model
issues.what: The 20x5 protocol ran 95/100 trials (95 correct, 0 failures). The 5 'qualified-local-alternative' trials need a second, independently qualified local diagnosis model; none exists on Omniverse2 (qwen3.8:27b failed the single-response diagnosis; it was not tried stepwise).
issues.impact: If the only qualified diagnosis model fails or is withdrawn, there is no qualified local fallback; recovery then closes BLOCKED for a human.
issues.human_action: Decide whether a second local model is qualified (stepwise) for diagnosis, or accept single-model diagnosis. Owner 2026-10-26: 95/100 accepted.

issues.title: Token usage UNKNOWN for 23 of 95 protocol trials
issues.what: The native path did not report usage for 23 trials; the ledger keeps them as UNKNOWN (never as zero).
issues.impact: Mission budgets for those requests are reconciled conservatively; cost per trial is not exact.
issues.human_action: Decide whether exact usage is required (adapter change) or the conservative UNKNOWN handling is acceptable.

issues.title: Stepwise inspector: held-out false-alarm rate not yet re-measured
issues.what: Calibration on the 9 registered held-out baselines (3 identical runs): 49/54 seeded defects caught, 5/9 clean baselines falsely rejected. Fixes were then developed on that spent subset as learning set 2 (L2 live: 59/63 after round 1; round 2 running). Their held-out effect is unmeasured.
issues.impact: In real runs the advisory inspector may still register false gaps for the end-of-run human review (advisory mode: it does not block).
issues.human_action: Release a frozen Feature 015 batch and decide its learning/test split (recorded seed) so the refreshed held-out set can measure the fixes.

issues.title: Escalation ladder: CAPA retrieval rung not integrated
issues.what: Every gap's attempt record lists rework, progress extension, validated lessons, diagnosis repair (AFO) and stall detection. CAPA retrieval is not a rung yet. Resolved 2026-10-26 (5f6d540): capa_retrieval rung records the linked CAPAs.
issues.impact: A gap may be registered although an open CAPA already describes its cause; the reviewer must check the CAPA registry.
issues.human_action: None needed to decide; implementation pending.

issues.title: Two inherited test failures
issues.what: test_cre_d7_final::test_readiness_is_recomputable_evidence_based_and_never_a_safety_claim and test_sim_renode::test_renode_found_from_mcp_server_environment fail identically on the base f6ff873.
issues.impact: The whole inherited suite is not green; the two failures predate Feature 014.
issues.human_action: Decide: fix in their own feature, or record a waiver.

issues.title: No usable parallel model serving for the inspector
issues.what: Ollama 0.34.0 serves qwen35moe with one request slot. The experimental llama.cpp profile (-ls) serves 2 slots but gives the prefill-bound inspector ~0 speed-up, changes answers (1 learning-set result broke) and crashed twice right after stack start (cause unknown).
issues.impact: Inspector throughput stays one request at a time on Omniverse2.
issues.human_action: Decide whether parallel serving is worth a separate qualification (another runtime or model), or keep one slot.

issues.title: Omniverse2 unit gate skips the review tests
issues.what: 40 of 46 review/seeded tests skip on Omniverse2 (no pinned SafeC engine or owner inputs there). Compensated: calibration requires a loop10 run of the same revision with none skipped.
issues.impact: A remote-only change could pass the remote gate untested.
issues.human_action: Decide whether the pinned engine and owner inputs may be placed on Omniverse2 (private data).

issues.title: Record copier misses some evaluation records
issues.what: The periodic copier of the seeded harness keeps inspection records for about 40 of 49 evaluations; the rest are lost when the harness deletes its scratch.
issues.impact: Replay-based development and audits cannot see every evaluation.
issues.human_action: None needed to decide; harness change pending (write records next to the result).

issues.title: Signed dispositions and patch bundles not exercised live
issues.what: Export, owner-signed dispositions and the signed patch-import gate pass their deterministic tests. A live round trip needs the owner's allowed-signers lines for namespaces forge-review-disposition and forge-patch-bundle and the owner's own signatures.
issues.impact: The offline improvement loop is implemented but unproven end to end.
issues.human_action: Owner: add the two allowed-signers lines and sign one disposition and one patch.

issues.title: Independent CRE rejects promotion of the branch
issues.what: Independent CRE evaluates the Feature 014 range as REJECTED / PROTECTED_PATH_CHANGE (the branch changes evidence and specification paths). No gate is waived.
issues.impact: No automatic promotion; merging needs the owner's review.
issues.human_action: Owner review of PR #42 (draft); merge only after acceptance.

issues.title: Long live campaigns not run
issues.what: Real RCC recovery, the 30-product benchmark, chronological learning benefit and the 24/72/168-hour operation campaigns are implemented with fixtures but NOT_RUN.
issues.impact: Production readiness, product success, learning benefit and availability are unproven.
issues.human_action: Schedule dedicated Omniverse2 GPU windows for the campaigns.
